request.subject: PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:PATROL_BOAT

layers.text: Turn it into a ramshackle goblin junk-boat: the hull becomes dark brown planks, colour #5a3414 with #391501 shadows, patched with a riveted gunmetal scrap plate; the red sail becomes patched warm brown leather, colour #955627 with #562a0c shadows, with two stitched pale hide patches; the pennant becomes a brown rag. Keep the boat shape, mast, size, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
